name: Projected Maximal Degree / Projected Maximum Positive Degree
details: Total degree dominates positive degree on every coordinate trace.
witness_verification: For the n-singleton class with n at least two, projected maximal degree equals star number n-1, while every trace has maximum positive degree at most one and a two-coordinate trace attains one.
proof: For every S, $\mathrm{d}_{\max}(\mathcal H_{|S})\geq\mathrm{d}^{+}_{\max}(\mathcal H_{|S})$. Maximize both sides over S.
